return function(conf, ctx)
  local core = require("apisix.core")
  local token = core.request.header(ctx, "Authorization")
  if not token then
    return 401, { message = "missing authorization token" }
  end
  token = token:gsub("^[Bb]earer%s+", "")
  local payload = token:match("^[^.]+%.([^.]+)%.")
  if not payload then
    return 401, { message = "invalid authorization token" }
  end
  payload = payload:gsub("-", "+"):gsub("_", "/")
  local padding = #payload % 4
  if padding > 0 then
    payload = payload .. string.rep("=", 4 - padding)
  end
  local decoded = ngx.decode_base64(payload)
  if not decoded then
    return 401, { message = "invalid authorization token payload" }
  end
  local claim = function(name)
    return decoded:match('"' .. name .. '"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"') or ""
  end
  if claim("token_type") ~= "access" then
    return 401, { message = "access token required" }
  end
  core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-User-ID", claim("sub"))
  core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-Tenant-ID", claim("tenant_id"))
  core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-Tenant-Slug", claim("tenant"))
  core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-User-Role", claim("role"))
end
